senses.gloss: ch. same; (act. verb) צְעַר [to diminish,] disregard, shame, curse (cmp. גדף, חסד). Targ. II Esth. II, 5 (transl. of תקלל, Ex. XXII, 27).
units: Targ. Prov. XXX, 11 נִיצְעֵיר ed. Lag. (oth. ed. נִצְעַר; ed. Wil. נְצַעֵר Pa.; h. text קלל).
Ib. 10 נִיצְעֲרִיךְ ed. Lag. (oth. ed. נְצַעֲרִינָךְ, Pa.).
<cite ref="Megillah 28a">Meg. 28ᵃ</cite> when going to bed he used to pray, <he>שרא … לכל מאן דצַעֲרָן</he> the Lord forgive every one that may have insulted me.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 26:6">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVI, 6</cite> (not <he>צעד׳</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 18:4">Targ. Job XVIII, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:2">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו קא מְצַעֲרֵי ליה טובא</he> they annoyed him exceedingly.

<cite ref="Berakhot 27b:20">Ib. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>עד כמה נצַעֲרִיה וניזיל</he> how long shall he go on vexing him? <cite ref="Nazir 23b:12">Naz. 23ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Horayot 10b">Hor. 10ᵇ</cite> sq. (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 2:9">Deut. II, 9</cite>) <he>מלחמה הוא דלא הא צַעוּרֵי צֵעֲרִינְהוּ</he> war you must not wage (against Moab), but you may afflict them (put them under tribute); <he>אפי׳ צַעוּרֵי לא</he> you must not even afflict them (the Ammonites); (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38b:5">B. Kam. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>עביד בהו אנגריא</he>). Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ bot. <he>כן … לצעורי וכ׳</he> is that your custom, to trouble your teacher? <cite ref="Chullin 95a:5">Ḥull. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>לצַעוּרֵיה</he>, v. <cite ref="K00296"><he>כּוּן</he></cite> ch.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:4">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>הוו מְצַעֲרֵי לאדכוריה</he> they took pains (in vain) to recall (what they had learned; Ms. M. <he>הוו יתבי ומִצְטַעֲרֵי</he> they sat and grieved; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 11:1">Targ. Y. Num. XI, 1</cite> (h. text <he>מתאננ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 7:15">Targ. Ps. VII, 15</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 104a:3">Keth. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>חלץ … וקמִצְטַעֵר</he> he put his T’fillin off and put them on again, and was in pain.
<cite ref="Shabbat 140b:18">Sabb. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>עד דמִיצְטַעֲרָן</he> until they were vexed (by curiosity).
<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:4">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> Ms. M, v. supra; a. fr.
